source: Generated with Canva AI image generation (Canva connector → generate-image), exported from Canva as JPG (1920×1080 or 1600×1200 export of ~1680 px originals), then converted to WebP with scripts/optimize-images.mjs (1400 px large + 720 px small).
terms: AI-generated in the teacher's own Canva account. Use is governed by the Canva Terms of Use / AI product terms of that account. No third-party stock images. Not independently checked by a lawyer — the teacher should confirm the terms of the Canva plan used (especially for the school account).
notes: Style for all scenes: modern, bright children's picture-book illustration, 2D digital painting, rounded shapes, consistent characters (Mia, Sam, Pepper the cat, Ms. Rosa).
Character consistency: every scene used the character sheet (characters.jpg) as a reference image.
Images contain no English words or labels; all teaching text is HTML.

Images 1–16 were made with the first Canva connection. After a credit cool-down the user connected another Canva account (the user said: school account); images 17–23 were made there, with the character sheet uploaded as reference.
Every image was reviewed by eye (full size and contact sheet): target action visible, correct hand/object, no extra text, no broken anatomy found.
